description: Retrieve works associated with an ORCID iD — publications, datasets, software, preprints, and more. Returns work summaries with put-codes, titles, types, publication dates, journal names, and all external identifiers (DOIs, PMIDs, arXiv IDs, ISBNs). Narrow the list with work_types and year_from/year_to; the filters run over the whole record before paging, so matchedCount counts every match and workCount the whole record. The first 25 matching works are returned by default; page with offset and the returned nextOffset, or raise limit. Set include_external_ids to false to omit identifier lists for a lighter payload. Pass the putCode from each work to orcid_get_work_detail to retrieve the full record including abstract and contributors. External IDs are ready for chaining to Crossref, PubMed, or arXiv servers. Works come from the researcher or from member organizations such as Crossref or a university system; each work lists its sources and whether the researcher asserted it (selfAsserted). A researcher may not have linked all their publications.

include_external_ids.description: When true (default), each work carries its external identifiers (DOIs, PMIDs, arXiv IDs, ISBNs). Set false to omit them for a lighter payload when only titles, types, and dates are needed.

limit.description: Works per page. Default 25; a larger value returns at most 1,000 and says so.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first matching work to return (default 0). Continue with nextOffset.

orcid_id.description: ORCID iD — bare (0000-0001-2345-6789) or as an orcid.org URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789). The check digit may be X or x.

work_types.description: Keep only works of these types, matched against each workType (e.g. ["journal-article", "preprint"]; ORCID spells datasets data-set). Any listed type matches; an empty list keeps every type.

items.description: A work type in ORCID's vocabulary.

year_from.description: Keep only works published in or after this year, read from the first four digits of publicationDate. Under either year bound, works with no publication date are left out and counted in the notice.

year_to.description: Keep only works published in or before this year; not before year_from.

name: orcid_get_works

appliedFilters.description: The filters applied before paging, present only when one is set.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `profile_not_found`: The ORCID iD does not correspond to a registered researcher. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matchedCount.description: Works matching work_types and the year range, before offset and limit; equals workCount when no filter is set.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass on the next call, with the same filters, to continue paging. Omitted when this response includes the last matching work.

notice.description: Deprecated-iD disclosure naming the primary iD, requested/effective limit disclosure, the count of undated works a year filter left out, no-match or past-end guidance, or empty-record guidance: works may be private or not yet added.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the matching works applied for this response.

returnedCount.description: Number of works returned in this response.

truncated.description: True when more matching works follow this page — fetch them with nextOffset.

workCount.description: Total works on this ORCID record, before filters, offset, and limit.

works.description: Matching works in ORCID order, sliced to the requested offset and limit.

items.description: Work summary record — one ORCID work group, built from its preferred version.

externalIds.description: External identifiers of the whole ORCID work group (DOIs, PMIDs, arXiv IDs, ISBNs, etc.): the preferred version's own, part-of IDs such as an ISSN included, then each identifier only another source in the group holds. Omitted when include_external_ids is false.

relationship.description: Relationship to the work (self or part-of).

type.description: Identifier type (e.g. doi, pmid, arxiv, isbn).

url.description: Resolver URL for this identifier, if available.

putCode.description: Work put-code — pass to orcid_get_work_detail to fetch the full record including abstract and contributors.

sources.description: Every party that added this work to the ORCID record, one entry per distinct source in the work group, the preferred version's first. Empty when ORCID records no source.

items.description: A party that asserted this item on the ORCID record.

assertionOriginName.description: Party the source added the item on behalf of, when ORCID records one — usually the researcher, for an item added through a search-and-link tool.

name.description: Name of the person or member organization system that added the item (e.g. a university research information system, Crossref, Scopus - Elsevier). Absent when ORCID records no name.

selfAsserted.description: True when the asserting party (the assertion origin when recorded, otherwise the source) is the record's ORCID iD (orcidId); false when a member organization or another ORCID user asserted the item.

url.description: URL for the work, if available.

workType.description: Work type in ORCID's vocabulary (e.g. journal-article, data-set, software, preprint), taken from the preferred version.

title: Get ORCID Researcher Works
